integrity: All finite- and infinite-grid statements are supported by an explicit analytic derivation; a standalone standard-library checker supplies supplementary finite tests. No empirical result is treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite-grid and asymptotic results concern homogeneous covariant transport along one smooth closed rank-one 2-by-2 path, with exact tangent projectors; no claim for nonzero forcing, inexact bases, general control gradients, or arbitrary state paths. Historical novelty cannot be certified exhaustively.
title: Exact attenuation and first-order holonomy defect of rank-one projected transport
